name: language-coach
description: A Claude Code mod that checks and translates prompts in the background, with feedback above the prompt and in a /coach pane.

target_language.title: Target language
target_language.description: Language to translate into or check grammar against.

source_language.title: Back-translation language
source_language.description: Optional language for translating the improved prompt back to verify its meaning. Leave empty to disable.

coach_model.title: Coach model
coach_model.description: Claude model alias or ID, using the current session's credentials and usage quota.

enabled.title: Enable coaching
enabled.description: Automatically review submitted prompts in interactive sessions.
